name: movscript
description: MovScript workspace skills backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript workspace editing guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. Workspace content lives as files under the frontend-owned .movscript directory; review/apply remains a UI boundary.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's frontend workspace model contract, edit the workspace file, then hand off review/apply to the MovScript UI.
